objectives: Acquire legitimate access to the approved normative and appraisal content
Preserve competition, competence, accreditation and independence
authorization_gates: Legal entity and billing identity are confirmed
At least two suitable proposals are compared when the market permits
Contract and payment are explicitly authorized
prohibitions: No unlicensed copying of ISO or CMMI content
No claim of accreditation based only on a provider statement
No consultant may certify work where prohibited independence conflicts exist
No purchase, contract or external message without authorized approval
